[ S. trasati, trasyati], trembles, shakes; is afraid (+ gen. or instr.) ; Dhātup 322 (tasa trasa ubbege); Dhātum 448; Dhp 130 (sabbe ~anti daṇḍassa); Sn 394 (ye thāvarā ye ca ~anti loke, Ee so; Be, Ce, Se tasā santi); Ja III 289, 4* (~asi bhamasi lenam icchasi); Nidd I 371, 16 (na vedheyya … na ~eyya na uttaseyya …); Ap 28, 18 (gajjato te … ~anti mārakāyikā); Cp 2:9:8 (kadāci so ~issati; Cp-a 171, 27 : so yakkho api ~eyya); Mil 148, 1 (arahā na ~ati sabbabhayehi); 208, 20 (yena pana mahārāja hetunā arahanto bhāyeyyuṃ vā ~eyyuṃ vā so hetu arahantānaṃ samucchinno); Pj II 228, 13 (iddhimanto bhiṃsanakarūpadassanena na ~antī ti, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee bhiṃsanakarūpena); — part.pr. tasanta, mfn. , Thī-a 246, 1 (ubbiggā ti ~antā); — pp tasita , mfn. , frightened, full of fear ; Bv 2:170 (ubbiggā ~ā bhītā); Cp 2:6:6 (dhanikehi bhīto ~o; Cp-a 146, 22 : ~o ti utrasto); 3:9:5 (aggivegabhayā bhītā ~ā mātā pitā mama); Mil 155, 25 (so puriso daṇḍabhayā ~o ubbiggo); — neg. fpp atasitāya, atasitabba, mfn. , where there is no cause for fear ; S III 57, 27 (assutavā puthujjano atasitāye ṭhāne tāsaṃ āpajjati; Spk II 276, 3 : atasitāye ti atasitabbe abhāyitabbe ṭhānamhi); — caus. pr. 3 sg. ( a ) tāseti , ~ayati 1 , makes tremble; frightens, scares ; Vin III 147, 5* (~esi maṃ selaṃ yācamāno, Ce, Ee so; Be, Se selam āyācamāno) = Ja II 284, 24* ( Ce so; Be, Ee , Se ~esimaṃ; 285, 9´ : imaṃ maṇiṃ yācanto tvaṃ … maṃ ~esi; Ee omits maṃ); Ja II 398, 25´ (kiṃ maṃ tumhe ~ethā ti); Ap 28, 16 (jātimā eso pasū ~eti sabbadā); 355, 12 (~ayanti mamaṃ sadā, Ce, Ee, Se so; Be tāpayanti); Mil 209, 6 (te sattihatthā ekaṃ arahantaṃ upadhāvitvā ~eyyuṃ); Sp 65, 7* (sadevako pi ce loko āgantvā ~ayeyya maṃ); Sv 266, 16 (janaṃ ~essāmī ti); — part.pr. tāsenta, mfn. , Ja II 427, 10 ; V 335, 16´ (hatthi … manusse ~ento gehāni viddhaṃsento); — aor. 3 sg. tāsesi, Ja IV 273, 22´ ; Mhv 19:20 (supaṇṇarūpā hutvāna te ~esi mahorage); — absol. tāsetvā, Ja IV 181, 19 (mahājanaṃ bhāyetvā ~etvā); VI 460, 12 (rājānaṃ hatthe gahetvā asiṃ uggiritvā ~etvā); Dhp-a I 222, 18 (~etvā pucchiyamānā na kathessati); — pp tāsita, mfn. , Mhv 19:21; — ( b ) tasseti, tassayati, Sadd 566, 24 (tassa santajjane: tasseti tassayati puriso core); — see also tassanaka, tassanā.
